mapper.select: INSERT INTO PAYMENT_CANCEL ( CURRENT_TRX_NO, ORIGINAL_TRX_NO, ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ, CANCEL_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{cancel.posTrx}, #{cancel.originalPosTrx}, #{cancel.originalAttemptSeq}, #{cancel.cancelStatusValue} ) RETURNING CURRENT_TRX_NO AS posTrx, ORIGINAL_TRX_NO AS originalPosTrx, ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ AS originalAttemptSeq, CANCEL_STATUS AS cancelStatus, VAN_CANCEL_TRX_ID AS vanCancelTrxId, CANCEL_APPROVAL_NO AS cancelApprovalNo, DECLINE_CODE AS declineCode;

UPDATE PAYMENT_CANCEL SET CANCEL_STATUS = #{cancel.cancelStatusValue}, VAN_CANCEL_TRX_ID = #{cancel.vanCancelTrxId}, CANCEL_APPROVAL_NO = #{cancel.cancelApprovalNo}, DECLINE_CODE = #{cancel.declineCode}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE CURRENT_TRX_NO = #{cancel.posTrx} AND ORIGINAL_TRX_NO = #{cancel.originalPosTrx} AND ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ = #{cancel.originalAttemptSeq} AND CANCEL_STATUS = 'PENDING' RETURNING CURRENT_TRX_NO AS posTrx, ORIGINAL_TRX_NO AS originalPosTrx, ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ AS originalAttemptSeq, CANCEL_STATUS AS cancelStatus, VAN_CANCEL_TRX_ID AS vanCancelTrxId, CANCEL_APPROVAL_NO AS cancelApprovalNo, DECLINE_CODE AS declineCode

UPDATE PAYMENT_CANCEL SET CANCEL_STATUS = #{cancel.cancelStatusValue}, VAN_CANCEL_TRX_ID = #{cancel.vanCancelTrxId}, CANCEL_APPROVAL_NO = #{cancel.cancelApprovalNo}, DECLINE_CODE = #{cancel.declineCode}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE CURRENT_TRX_NO = #{cancel.posTrx} AND ORIGINAL_TRX_NO = #{cancel.originalPosTrx} AND ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ = #{cancel.originalAttemptSeq} AND CANCEL_STATUS = 'UNKNOWN_TIMEOUT' RETURNING CURRENT_TRX_NO AS posTrx, ORIGINAL_TRX_NO AS originalPosTrx, ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ AS originalAttemptSeq, CANCEL_STATUS AS cancelStatus, VAN_CANCEL_TRX_ID AS vanCancelTrxId, CANCEL_APPROVAL_NO AS cancelApprovalNo, DECLINE_CODE AS declineCode

SELECT C.CURRENT_TRX_NO AS posTrx, C.ORIGINAL_TRX_NO AS originalPosTrx, C.ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ AS originalAttemptSeq, C.CANCEL_STATUS AS cancelStatus, C.VAN_CANCEL_TRX_ID AS vanCancelTrxId, C.CANCEL_APPROVAL_NO AS cancelApprovalNo, C.DECLINE_CODE AS declineCode FROM PAYMENT_CANCEL C WHERE 1 = 1 and C.ORIGINAL_TRX_NO = #{originalPosTrx} AND C.ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ = #{originalAttemptSeq} LIMIT 1

SELECT C.CURRENT_TRX_NO AS posTrx, C.ORIGINAL_TRX_NO AS originalPosTrx, C.ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ AS originalAttemptSeq, C.CANCEL_STATUS AS cancelStatus, C.VAN_CANCEL_TRX_ID AS vanCancelTrxId, C.CANCEL_APPROVAL_NO AS cancelApprovalNo, C.DECLINE_CODE AS declineCode FROM PAYMENT_CANCEL C WHERE 1 = 1 and C.CURRENT_TRX_NO = #{posTrx} LIMIT 1
